VISUAL PRACTICE / 2026

Focused on form, materials & light.

I’m Spandan De, a 3D artist and Animation & Multimedia student at Brainware University, Kolkata. My main focus is creating detailed 3D assets through modelling, texturing, materials, lighting and rendering.

I enjoy taking an object from reference to final render — studying its silhouette, refining proportions, building believable materials, and using lighting and composition to make the model feel tangible.

VFX and motion graphics are supporting parts of my practice. I use compositing, movement and visual effects when they strengthen a project, while 3D remains the centre of my portfolio and creative direction.

03 / PRODUCTION LOG

Good work is
a process.

My process starts with references and silhouette, then moves through modelling, materials, lighting and rendering. I bring in VFX or motion graphics only when they strengthen the final 3D presentation.

IDEA
→ FORM
01

Observe & research

Collect references, study the subject, and identify its key forms, materials and visual purpose.

⌕
02

Shape the direction

Block out proportions and silhouette before refining the model and committing to detail.

⌁
03

Build & refine

Refine the model, test materials, and build lighting that brings out the form and surface.

◈
04

Polish & present

Render, polish and present the final asset. Add compositing or motion only if it helps the work.

↗
